kv5.2:1.3: Sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:1.5: Nanu sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti, na passati, adiṭṭham aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:1.7: Hañci sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti, na passati, adiṭṭham aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharati, no vata re vattabbe
kv5.2:2.1: Asekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, asekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭham viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:2.3: Sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭham viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:3.1: Sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭham aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:3.3: Asekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, asekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv5.2:4.5: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa sotāpattiphale ñāṇaṃ atthīti?
kv5.2:4.7: anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya --pe-- arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa arahatte ñāṇaṃ atthīti?
kv5.2:5.4: Nanu āyasmā Ānando sekho "Bhagavā uḷāro ti" jānāti, "Sāriputto thero, Mahā Moggallāno thero uḷāro ti" jānātīti?
kv5.2:5.6: Hañci āyasmā Ānando sekho "Bhagavā uḷāro ti" jānāti, "Sāriputto thero, Mahā Moggallāno thero uḷāro ti" jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
